takeaways.text: Lines up **Slot** on **51%** of 70 plays (n=36); also Wide (outside) 49% (n=34).
Runs a route on **99%** of dropbacks — about the WR average (100%). Effectively always a receiver; blocking is negligible.
On routes, averages **9.2 yd** downfield by the throw vs 11.2 for WRs (shallower) (n=69, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Slot (51%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.

farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
